caption: The drawing depicts a decorative, ornate bed frame rendered in dark colors with intricate scrollwork and lattice designs. The bed frame is shown in two sections: the headboard is displayed separately above, while the main body of the bed, including the footboard and the sides, is shown below. On the lower bed, a woman lies on her back with her head turned slightly to the side, resting on a white pillow with lace trim. She has black hair and is dressed in colorful traditional clothing, featuring a mix of red, orange, blue, green, and gold patterns. A patterned blanket covers her, and her hands are resting by her sides. The overall composition is set on a neutral, off-white background. The artist’s name, “Dana Bartelt,” appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Doll Bed
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
